units.source_text: 自侍从人等以至万端事务，都托付紫姬掌管。

en.t: From the attendants and servants down to every kind of household affair, he entrusted everything to Lady Murasaki to manage.

units.source_text: 领地内庄园、牧场以及各处领地的契券，亦皆交与紫姬保藏。

en.t: The deeds for the estates, pastures, and holdings in every district were also all handed over to Lady Murasaki for safekeeping.

units.source_text: 此外无数仓库和储藏室，则由向来信任的少纳言乳母率领几个亲信的家臣管理，吩咐紫姬适当支配。

en.t: As for the countless storehouses and storerooms, he had the long trusted Nurse Shonagon manage them with several loyal retainers, and instructed Lady Murasaki to distribute their contents as she saw fit.

units.source_text: 源氏公子自己房里的中务君、中将等宠幸的侍女，过去虽然常恨公子薄情，但能时时相见，亦可聊以慰情；

en.t: The favored ladies who served in Prince Genji's own rooms, such as Lady Nakatsukasa and Lady Chujo, had often resented his coldness in the past, yet they could still console themselves by seeing him from time to time;

units.source_text: 今后群花无主，尚复有何乐趣？

en.t: but now that these many flowers would be left without their master, what pleasure could remain?
Everyone hung their heads in dejection.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对她们说：“我总有保全性命而平安归来之一日。

en.t: Prince Genji said to them, "One day I will surely preserve my life and return safely.

units.source_text: 凡愿意等候的人，都到西殿供职。”

en.t: All of you who are willing to wait for me should go serve in the western wing."

units.source_text: 教上下人等都迁往西殿。

en.t: He ordered all the people of every rank to move to the western wing.

units.source_text: 源氏公子按照各人身份，赐与种种物品，以为临别纪念。

en.t: Prince Genji gave various gifts to each person according to their rank, as keepsakes at parting.

units.source_text: 小公子夕雾的乳母及花散里，当然也都受得富有情趣的赠品。

en.t: The young lord Yugiri's nurse and Lady Hanachirusato naturally also received gifts chosen with refined feeling.

units.source_text: 此外关于诸人日常生计，无不顾虑周至。

en.t: Beyond this, he gave thorough consideration to every detail of everyone's daily livelihood.
